panels.title: Participants
panels.description: target = participants requested for the current step

panels.title: Join latency / time to first frame
Quality (what users would feel) — compare these between SFUs
Received video bitrate per track
panels.description: All viewers (no profile filter). By requested layer: the panel in the next row.

panels.title: Per-viewer quality (one sample per track per 5 s: the worst viewers, not the average packet)
Viewers with video fps ≤ 25
panels.description: Share of video tracks that got 25 fps or less in a 5 s window. Sent at 30 fps.

panels.title: Packet loss per viewer
panels.description: p95 of per-track loss %, and the share of tracks above 2% loss

targets.expr: 100 - 100 * sum by (kind, profile) (rate(bench_sub_track_loss_ratio_bucket{le=~"0.02(\\.0)?",profile=~"$profile"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (kind, profile) (rate(bench_sub_track_loss_ratio_count{profile=~"$profile"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Received / requested kbps per viewer
panels.description: 1.0 = the viewer gets the layer it asked for. The SLO line is min_video_ratio (0.8).

panels.title: Freeze length
panels.description: How long each freeze lasted (gap above loadgen.freeze_threshold). Many short ones and a few long ones feel different.

panels.title: Frames vs requested layer
panels.description: lower = the SFU downgraded the viewer (BWE / congestion); 0 on a clean network

panels.title: Received bitrate per track by requested layer
Publisher RTT to the SFU
panels.description: From the SFU's receiver reports. Rising with load = SFU queueing

panels.title: Disturbances and recovery (plans with events, churn, rejoin or network dips)
Recovery time (window 2m)
panels.description: Disturbance (or end of an outage) -> media again: first video keyframe, else audio

panels.title: Layer switch time (window 2m)
panels.description: down: dip start -> lower layer delivered; up: dip end -> the layer from before the dip back. LiveKit needs use_send_side_bwe: true

panels.title: Unmute heard
panels.description: Speaker unmute -> first audio of that talk spurt at a listener (plans with speakers)

panels.title: SFU per-core busy %
panels.description: IRQ cores should show softirq only; mediasoup: one line per pinned worker; a core at 100% = a saturated worker

panels.title: Generators — if these are saturated the step is INVALID
Generator send lag p99 (INVALID above report.max_gen_send_lag)
panels.description: Publisher frame tick -> write returned, sampled. Rising = the generator is late and its numbers are not trustworthy

panels.title: SFU internals (one of these is empty depending on which SFU runs)
